description: Pinned external source versions for every program in this repository. Governed by CONSTITUTION.md section 11. Updated any time a source is bumped. Retrieval dates should be updated whenever a pipeline refreshes its cache.

geoboundaries.notes: ADM1 polygons used for PHL, BGD, PAK, NPL, LKA, KHM, LAO, TLS in access-services.

world_bank_wdi.notes: Per-indicator retrieval date should be recorded in each generated row, not only here.

world_bank_cckp.notes: National-level climatology. Not sufficient for within-country ADM1 variation; see Constitution section 6.5.

worldpop_stats_api.notes: Flaky and rate-limited. Constitution section 11 recommends migrating to local raster zonal stats.

psa_openstat.dataset: 2020 Census of Population and Housing, Regional
psa_openstat.notes: Philippines ADM1 population. URL path is fragile; cache mandatory.

osm_overpass.notes: OSM is continuously edited. Reproducibility hazard per Constitution section 11. Planned migration to Overture monthly-versioned releases or a pinned Geofabrik planet extract.

ookla_open_data.notes: Manifest and DuckDB SQL committed; parquet not yet pulled. Opt-in via OOKLA_DOWNLOAD=1.

openaq_api.notes: API key required for live pulls. The 2026-06-19 air-monitoring station-metadata pass writes raw responses to git-ignored .cache/openaq-station-metadata/ and commits generated CSV/JSON retrieval records plus the fetch script. Two OpenAQ rows were excluded from station-coordinate counts because their coordinates fell outside broad target-country bounds.

air_monitoring_regulator_source_inventor.notes: First-pass public source-candidate inventory for 24 air-monitoring upgrade-queue economies. Source URLs, targeted-search gaps, retrieval statuses, and non-claims are committed in generated regulator-source inventory CSV/JSON records.

air_monitoring_regulator_station_extract.notes: Official station-source extraction for the 9 targeted air-monitoring regulator inventory, portal, or plan sources. The pass commits normalized station/source evidence, retrieval URLs, proximity diagnostics against OpenAQ station rows, and non-claims in generated regulator-station extraction CSV/JSON records.

air_monitoring_monitor_grade_evidence.notes: Monitor-grade evidence audit for the 239 official-source rows from the air-monitoring station-extraction pass. The audit verifies Bangladesh method-standard language and Sri Lanka sensor-under-test language, then separates method-standard signals, automatic or official-portal provenance, sensor-under-test caution rows, plan-only rows, and rows with no public grade language.

air_monitoring_official_openaq_reconcili.notes: Official-to-OpenAQ reconciliation audit for the 230 official coordinate rows from the air-monitoring station-extraction pass. The audit cross-tabulates nearest-OpenAQ within-5-kilometer signals and name-overlap signals, while keeping all rows as candidates until station IDs, documented crosswalks, or source-owner/current-status evidence validates a join.

air_monitoring_official_openaq_candidate.notes: Review worksheet for the 13 near-plus-name official/OpenAQ candidate rows from the reconciliation audit. The worksheet adds source metadata, row-level review questions, allowed decisions, and minimum validation evidence while keeping 0 rows validated and 0 rows station-radius-ready.

Public-evidence attachment for the 13 official/OpenAQ candidate worksheet rows. The audit joins OpenAQ owner/provider, isMonitor, sensor-count, and vintage metadata to each candidate row, while keeping explicit crosswalk evidence, validated same-station joins, and station-radius-ready rows at 0.

Public source scan for the 6 OpenAQ isMonitor candidate worksheet rows. The scan retrieves five public source URLs, screens all 6 rows as separate nearby stations, and keeps validated same-station joins and station-radius-ready rows at 0.

Public source scan for the 7 OpenAQ candidate worksheet rows not marked isMonitor. The scan retrieves 10 public source URLs, screens all 7 rows as public-feed nearby rows that are not join-ready, and keeps validated same-station joins and station-radius-ready rows at 0.

air_monitoring_one_signal_review_queue.notes: One-signal review queue after the near-plus-name candidate source scans. The queue combines 9 near-only official/OpenAQ rows, 22 name-only-not-near rows, and 138 automatic or official-portal monitor-grade provenance-only rows while keeping validated same-station joins, complete monitor-grade classifications, and station-radius-ready rows at 0.

air_monitoring_monitor_grade_source_vali.notes: Source-validation scan for the non-Bangladesh monitor-grade provenance-only lane. The scan retrieves 14 seeded public source URLs across 7 economies, covers all 138 provenance-only queue rows, finds method/equipment or standard context in 7 source rows, official/automatic context in 6 source rows, caution language in 1 source row, and keeps complete monitor-grade classifications and station-radius grade-assumption-ready rows at 0.

air_monitoring_monitor_grade_station_rev.notes: No-network station-review queue derived from the one-signal review queue and monitor-grade source-validation scan. It assigns all 138 provenance-only station rows to review lanes: 66 method-context rows needing station confirmation, 2 caution-blocked rows, 70 official-context-only rows, and still 0 complete monitor-grade or station-radius-ready rows.

air_monitoring_monitor_grade_station_met.notes: No-network station-row method-evidence audit derived from the station-review queue and official station-source extraction. It reviews the 66 method-context rows, finds 66 exact official station rows, 28 exact-row instrument hints, 38 PM2.5 portal/API rows without instrument wording on the exact row, 37 positive raw live PM2.5 values, 12 negative raw values, 1 sentinel, 16 missing raw values, and still 0 complete monitor-grade or station-radius-ready rows.

air_monitoring_uzbekistan_station_curren.notes: Public Uzhydromet maps API scan for the 28 Uzbekistan exact-row instrument-hint station rows. It finds all 28 target station IDs in the API, all 28 with station-level HORIBA markers, 5 API reading dates within 30 days, 22 API reading dates older than 365 days, 15 positive raw PM2.5 values, 12 negative raw values, 1 sentinel value, and still 0 explicit current-status confirmed, complete monitor-grade, or station-radius-ready rows.

air_monitoring_uzbekistan_method_policy_.notes: Seeded public source-policy scan for Uzbekistan method, equipment, reading-cadence, and station-status context. It scans 5 public official or technical sources, retrieves 4, finds 4 source rows with method/equipment context and 4 with cadence/status context, but 0 source rows naming a target station ID from the 28-row queue and still 0 current-status confirmed, complete monitor-grade, or station-radius-ready rows.

air_monitoring_uzbekistan_station_specif.notes: Official Uzbekistan station-specific source scan. It retrieves the Uzhydromet main map, 14 official regional station-table pages, 28 official station-detail pages, and one gov.uz ecology note; parses 93 regional station rows; matches all 28 target Uzbekistan rows to official regional station-table rows; finds 28 station-detail URLs whose numeric path matches the internal target station ID, 26 detail measurements within 30 days, 22 rows where the regional table carries Horiba station context, 2 rows also named in the official gov.uz event note, and 1 negative sentinel detail PM2.5 value; but 0 rows are current-status confirmed, complete monitor-grade, or station-radius-ready.

air_monitoring_uzbekistan_status_certifi.notes: Seeded public source scan for Uzbekistan station-status, certification, maintenance, calibration, and reference-grade context after the station-ID gate. It retrieves 7 public sources, finds source-level method context in 6 sources, operating or online context in 7 sources, certification or standards context in 3 sources, maintenance/training context in 1 source, 2 additional exact station event mentions, 2 stale station-detail follow-up rows, 1 sentinel detail PM2.5 row, and still 0 current-status confirmed, station-method classified, complete monitor-grade, or station-radius-ready rows.

air_monitoring_uzbekistan_blocker_row_fo.notes: Exact row-level follow-up for the 3 Uzbekistan blocker rows left by the status/certification scan. It retrieves 2 official regional table pages and 3 exact official station-detail pages, finds 2 stale detail rows with regional Updating data status and 1 recent Sergili row with a -9999 PM2.5 sentinel, and still resolves 0 public blockers, 0 current-status confirmations, 0 complete monitor-grade rows, and 0 station-radius-ready rows.

air_monitoring_indonesia_georgia_row_met.notes: Seeded and expanded public source scan for the 38 Indonesia and Georgia exact PM2.5 portal/API rows. It retrieves 29 of 29 source URLs, including 22 BMKG station-detail pages, finds 22 Indonesia same-page method-context candidates and 9 Georgia station-alias context candidates, and still keeps current-status confirmed, station-method classified, complete monitor-grade, and station-radius-ready rows at 0.

air_monitoring_station_code_status_metho.notes: Strict station-code/status source scan for 41 unresolved rows: 16 Georgia air.gov.ge station-code API rows, 22 Indonesia BMKG PM2.5 portal payload rows, and 3 Uzbekistan blocker rows carried forward from the exact blocker follow-up. It finds 41 exact station code or ID rows, 16 Georgia PM2.5 equipment rows, 15 Georgia operating-description context rows, 1 Georgia test-mode row, 22 Indonesia BMKG station-code payload rows, 3 unresolved Uzbekistan blockers, and still 0 station method-table, current-status confirmed, complete monitor-grade, or station-radius-ready rows.

air_monitoring_station_grade_decision_le.notes: No-network station-grade decision ledger for the 66 exact method-context station rows. It joins committed source-scan artifacts into row-level decision lanes, records 66 exact source rows, 50 method-context rows, 16 raw-value or blocker cautions, and keeps current-status confirmed, station-method classified, complete monitor-grade, and station-radius-ready rows at zero.

who_aaq_database.notes: WHO Ambient Air Quality Database. Excel download; hash in manifest.sha256 once committed.

earth_engine_assets.notes: Earth Engine export scaffolds exist (e.g., Sentinel-5P NO2) but no asset is committed to the pipeline yet. Record asset ID and export date per asset when activated.

adb_aric_economy_list.source: ADB Asia Regional Integration Center, Asia and the Pacific economy grouping
adb_aric_economy_list.notes: Defines the 50 ADB regional member economies used for scale-out screens.

doh_nhfr_phl.name: DOH National Health Facility Registry v2.0
doh_nhfr_phl.access_model: A (public, JWT issued per landing page; no login required)
doh_nhfr_phl.notes: Used by Program 13 (public-service-data-quality) to compare against OSM-mapped health amenities from access-services pipeline.
